lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are distributed posterior to the branchial region, forming a repeating 2D spatial matrix along the lateral mid-line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive patterning of high-density, small-diameter high-luminance blobs is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin and the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits.
